name: Jewel Duel
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Duel is a unique fusion between a matching jewel game and a fighting game. In this online game, you can defeat giant snakes and gigantic insects while matching jewels. At the start of the game, you can choose your preference of language. Then you can choose to play as a Marwin the wizard, Isabela the assassin, or Caldur the warrior. Each character has their own weaknesses and strengths that must be considered before you make your final choice. Go to the map, and choose which journey you want to take by clicking on the available dots. Depending on what tiles you match, you will complete a certain action that will help you in fighting against the creatures. Use the coins you earn to purchase upgrades, weapons, and abilities that can help give you an advantage.
